The structure of Ba8Mo4O20 (reduced formula Ba2MoO5) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mo centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ba centers exhibit a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 O neighbors. The Mo octahedra share corners with one another, and face-sharing is observed between Ba polyhedra and Mo octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
